packageRules.description: The exam runs Kubernetes 1.35: only patch releases of the kind node image
The Python emitter stays on 3.13 with Alpine

prBodyNotes: This pull request changes `versions.env`. The `sync-versions` workflow then commits the matching course files to this branch. Before merging:
- [ ] Check that the `sync-versions` commit is on this branch and the `versions` check is green.
- [ ] Run `astrona test` on every lab that uses this tool (the `labs` workflow tests every section for a `versions.env` change).
- [ ] For kube-prometheus-stack or Argo CD: set the values without a `# renovate:` comment in `versions.env` to the images the new release runs.
- [ ] Run the playground commands on the pages and replace any command output that changed.
